name: agent-inbox
title: Agent inbox
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Background workshop tasks in one list, with age, the last steps, and approve, send back, or try again.

meta.descriptionEs: Trabajo de fondo del taller en una lista, con la edad, los últimos pasos y aprobar, devolver o reintentar.

examples.title: Bandeja del taller
examples.description: El anticipo espera un visto y el aviso a Celaya se puede reintentar.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Vacío, textos largos, RTL, carga y diez tareas.

meta.usage: <AgentInbox tasks={tasks} now={now} filter={filter} openIds={openIds} onApprove={approve} onSendBack={sendBack} onRetry={retry} />

api.name: tasks
api.description: id, title, summary, agent, status (needs-you, running, failed, done), startedAt, steps. meta is opaque.

api.name: now
api.description: Epoch milliseconds used for ages. Omit it and the age stays hidden.

api.name: filter / openIds
api.description: Which group is showing, and which rows are unfolded.

api.name: onApprove / onSendBack / onRetry / onOpen
api.description: Approve work that is waiting, send it back, try a failed task again, or open it.

api.name: loading / error
api.description: Loading skeleton, or an alert when the inbox cannot be read.

api.name: labels
api.description: Chrome copy. English is the default.

docs: Inspirado en el comportamiento público de una bandeja de tareas de fondo; reimplementación clean-room; no código, datos, iconos ni assets de Affect. Si el CLI pregunta si debe sobrescribir un primitivo que el anfitrión ya tiene (badge, button, skeleton), responde no. La pieza no trae tema, cssVars ni colores fijos. No anima el cambio de lugar.
